g.text: John Oliver Dunks on Midterms Losers Elon Musk and Haley Stevens ◆ Goldwyn Bets on French WW2 Epic ‘De Gaulle’ Crossing Over to U.S. Audiences: ‘It’s the Story of an Ally’ ◆ China Box Office: ‘Traces of Justice’ Reclaims Top Spot as Local Debuts ‘Embers’ and ‘The Coffin Swap’ Arrive ◆ ‘Love Is Blind’ Creator on Protecting the Cast and Why He Chose to Keep Rob’s Attack on Production in the Final Cut ◆ ‘Wanted’ Broadway Review: Dazzling Cast Can’t Elevate the Musical’s Muted Narrative ◆ Taiwan and South Korea Join Forces on Musical Theater Co-Productions ◆
